about: Measured values of an open-access article, in the format of thermoml_<id>.json (read by measured_components.ThermoML together with the ThermoML file). The pure ethyl levulinate end points (x1 = y1 = 1) of the isobaric vapour-liquid equilibrium sets of Table 2 (modified Rose-Williams still) and the boiling temperature of Table 1 (exp. column; the lit. column is calculated with Aspen and is not used), read from the page images and checked against the PDF's text layer. Each row is a vapour pressure: the stated pressure at the measured boiling temperature. Uncertainty: expanded (k = 2) from the stated standard uncertainties u(T) = 0.04 K and u(P) = 0.1 kPa (Table 2 footnote; Table 1 states u(T) = 0.04 K and no u(P), the same 0.1 kPa is assumed), U(P) = 2 sqrt(u(P)^2 + (P dlnP/dT u(T))^2) with dlnP/dT = 0.0288 1/K from the article's own end points at 40.0 and 80.0 kPa.

source.citation: W. Bo, X. Zhang, Q. Zhang, L. Chen, J. Liu, L. Ma, S. Ma, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium of Biomass-Derived Ethyl Levulinate and Ethanol at 40.0, 60.0 and 80.0 kPa, Energies 18 (2025) 3939
